profile_text.body:
Character.AI is a company founded in 2022 that operates a persona-based AI chat platform at character.ai. The company describes its product as "the #1 AI chat app," offering users the ability to converse with a large variety of AI characters. Its site frames the experience around user-driven creativity, with the tagline "Your Words. Your World."

The company's primary product, tracked under the chat and general LLMs category, is the Character.ai platform itself. The site's held facts note that the product carries HR and appropriate-use risk considerations, which is relevant given the platform's open-ended, character-driven chat format accessible to a broad user base. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are currently on file for the company.
